arxiv-1905-10130.title: Search for magnetic monopoles and stable high-electric-charge objects in 13 TeV proton–proton collisions with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1905-10130.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by . A search for magnetic monopoles and high-electric-charge objects is presented using 34.4 fb -1 of 13 TeV p ​ p pp collision data collected by the ATLAS detector at the LHC during 2015 and 2016. The considered signature is based upon high ionization in the transition radiation tracker of the inner detector associated with a pencil-shape energy deposit in the electromagnetic calorimeter. The data were collected by a dedicated trigger based on the tracker high-threshold hit capability.

arxiv-2101-10229.title: Universal Approximation Properties for an ODENet and a ResNet: Mathematical Analysis and Numerical Experiments
arxiv-2101-10229.creator: Yuto Aizawa, Masato Kimura, Kazunori Matsui
arxiv-2101-10229.description: Abstract We prove a universal approximation property (UAP) for a class of ODENet and a class of ResNet, which are simplified mathematical models for deep learning systems with skip connections. The UAP can be stated as follows. Let n n and m m be the dimension of input and output data, and assume m ≤ n m\leq n .

arxiv-2103-08125.title: Modelling Human Kinetics and Kinematics during Walking using Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2103-08125.creator: Visak Kumar
arxiv-2103-08125.description: Abstract In this work, we develop an automated method to generate 3D human walking motion in simulation which is comparable to real-world human motion. At the core, our work leverages the ability of deep reinforcement learning methods to learn high-dimensional motor skills while being robust to variations in the environment dynamics.

arxiv-2104-07127.title: Polarity relevance in flux-rope trajectory deflections triggered by coronal holes
arxiv-2104-07127.creator: A. Sahade, M. Cécere, A. Costa, H. Cremades
arxiv-2104-07127.description: Abstract Context. Many observations suggest that coronal holes (CHs) are capable of deviating the trajectory of coronal mass ejections (CMEs) away from them. However, for some peculiar events, the eruption has been reported to be initially pulled towards the CH and then away from it. Aims.

arxiv-2210-05763.creator: Sean T. Linden, Aaron S. Evans, Lee Armus, Jeffrey A. Rich, Kirsten L. Larson, Thomas Lai, George C. Privon, Vivian U, Hanae Inami, Thomas Bohn, Yiqing Song, Loreto Barcos-Muñoz, Vassilis Charmandaris, Anne M. Medling, Sabrina Stierwalt, Tanio Diaz-Santos, Torsten Böker, Paul van der Werf, Susanne A
arxiv-2210-05763.description: Abstract We present the results of a James Webb Space Telescope NIRCam investigation into the young massive star cluster (YMC) population in the luminous infrared galaxy VV 114. We identify 374 compact YMC candidates with a S / N ≥ 3 S/N\geq 3 , 5, and 5 at F150W, F200W, and F356W respectively.

arxiv-2212-04999.title: An Implementation of the Extended Tower Number Field Sieve using 4-dimensional Sieving in a Box and a Record Computation in 𝔽 p 4 \mathbb{F}_{p^{4}}
arxiv-2212-04999.creator: Oisín Robinson
arxiv-2212-04999.description: Abstract We report on an implementation of the Extended Tower Number Field Sieve (ExTNFS) and record computation in a medium characteristic finite field 𝔽 p 4 \mathbb{F}_{p^{4}} of 512 bits size. Empirically, we show that sieving in a 4-dimensional box (orthotope) for collecting relations for ExTNFS in 𝔽 p 4 \mathbb{F}_{p^{4}} is faster than sieving in a 4-dimensional hypersphere.

arxiv-2312-08411.title: Pose and shear-based tactile servoing
arxiv-2312-08411.creator: John Lloyd \affilnum 1,2 and Nathan F. Lepora \affilnum 1,2
arxiv-2312-08411.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by John Lloyd \affilnum 1,2 and Nathan F. Lepora \affilnum 1,2. Tactile servoing is an important technique because it enables robots to manipulate objects with precision and accuracy while adapting to changes in their environments in real-time. One approach for tactile servo control with high-resolution soft tactile sensors is to estimate the contact pose relative to an object surface using a convolutional neural network (CNN) for use as a feedback signal.

arxiv-2404-01771.title: On the Rings whose injective right modules are max-projective
arxiv-2404-01771.creator: Yusuf Alagöz, ENGİN Büyükaşık, Haydar Baran Yurtsever
arxiv-2404-01771.description: Abstract . Recently, the rings whose injective right modules are R R -projective (respectively, max-projective) were investigated and studied in [ 4 ] . Such ring are called right almost- Q ​ F QF (respectively, max- Q ​ F QF ).

arxiv-2409-16657.title: Post-Transition Metal Sn-Based Chalcogenide Perovskites: A Promising Lead-Free and Transition Metal Alternative for Stable, High-Performance Photovoltaics
arxiv-2409-16657.creator: Surajit Adhikari*, Sankhasuvra Das, and Priya Johari
arxiv-2409-16657.description: Abstract Chalcogenide perovskites (CPs) have emerged as promising materials for optoelectronic applications due to their stability, non-toxicity, small bandgaps, high absorption coefficients, and defect tolerance. Although transition metal-based CPs, particularly those incorporating Zr and Hf, have been well-studied, they often exhibit higher bandgaps, lower charge carrier mobility, and reduced efficiency compared to lead-based halide perovskites (HPs).

arxiv-2511-04582.title: Embedding Calculus, Goodwillie calculus and link invariants
arxiv-2511-04582.creator: Hyeonhee Jin
arxiv-2511-04582.description: Abstract . We study Goodwillie-Weiss’ embedding calculus through its relationship with Goodwillie’s functor calculus. Specifically, building on a result of Tillmann and Weiss, we construct a functorial complement for T n T_{n} -embeddings that takes values in Heuts’ categorical n n -excisive approximation of pointed spaces.

arxiv-2511-22252.title: Stochastic Models of Resource Allocation in Chemical Reaction Networks
arxiv-2511-22252.creator: Vincent Fromion, Philippe Robert, Jana Zaherddine
arxiv-2511-22252.description: Abstract . This paper analyses of a stochastic model of a chemical reaction network with three types of chemical species ℛ {\cal R} , ℳ {\cal M} and 𝒰 {\cal U} that interact to transform a flow of external resources, the chemical species 𝒬 {\cal Q} , to produce a product, the chemical species 𝒫 r {\cal P}_{r} .

pmc-10587055.title: High‐fat diet increases electron transfer flavoprotein synthesis and lipid respiration in skeletal muscle during exercise training in female mice
pmc-10587055.creator: Philip M Batterson, Erin M McGowan, Agnieszka K Borowik, Michael T Kinter, Benjamin F Miller, Sean A Newsom, Matthew M Robinson
pmc-10587055.description: High‐fat diet (HFD) and exercise remodel skeletal muscle mitochondria. The electron transfer flavoproteins (ETF) transfer reducing equivalents from β‐oxidation into the electron transfer system. Exercise may stimulate the synthesis of ETF proteins to increase lipid respiration. We determined mitochondrial remodeling for lipid respiration through ETF in the context of higher mitochondrial abundance/capacity seen in female mice.

pmc-10854250.title: Banded Helical Space Regainer—an Innovative Approach for Management of Space Loss: A Case Report
pmc-10854250.creator: Neeti Tatiya, Rituraj Kesri, Kirti Pattanshetti, Shreya Sankalecha
pmc-10854250.description: The transitory phase of the mixed dentition to a permanent one is seldom accurate, the hurdles being space loss, tooth size arch length discrepancy, early exfoliation of primary teeth, or premature eruption of permanent teeth. Space regainers are appliances used to regain and maintain space, so as to guide the unerupted tooth into the proper position in the arch.

pmc-11431728.title: Increased Motility in Campylobacter jejuni and Changes in Its Virulence, Fitness, and Morphology Following Protein Expression on Ribosomes with Altered RsmA Methylation
pmc-11431728.creator: Agnieszka Sałamaszyńska-Guz, Małgorzata Murawska, Paweł Bącal, Agnieszka Ostrowska, Ewelina Kwiecień, Ilona Stefańska, Stephen Douthwaite, Grzegorz Wegrzyn, Vipin Chandra Kalia
pmc-11431728.description: Infection with Campylobacter jejuni is the major cause of human gastroenteritis in the United States and Europe, leading to debilitating autoimmune sequelae in many cases. While considerable progress has been made in detailing the infectious cycle of C. jejuni, a full understanding of the molecular mechanisms responsible for virulence remains to be elucidated.

pmc-11620250.title: Association between the oxidative balance score and estimated glomerular filtration rate: 2007–2018 NHANES
pmc-11620250.creator: Mingda Wu, Cuiting Dong, Zhen Yang, Yongfu Song, Chenkai Xu, Shuang Ma, Yuejiao Lan, Xiaodan Lu
pmc-11620250.description: Oxidative stress is closely associated with the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) levels. A comprehensive indicator for evaluating dietary and lifestyle exposures to oxidative stress is the Oxidative Balance Score (OBS), with higher OBS suggesting more substantial antioxidant exposures. The aim of this study is to explore the relationship between OBS and eGFR levels.

pmc-12590134.title: Clinical measures associated with aspiration risk in multiple system atrophy: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12590134.creator: Jun Tanimura, Toshiyuki Yamamoto, Yuji Takahashi
pmc-12590134.description: IntroductionIdentifying clinical measures associated with aspiration risk is crucial for guiding clinical decisions in patients with multiple system atrophy (MSA). We investigated whether basic clinical measures—including the Barthel index (BI), Unified MSA Rating Scale (UMSARS), and dopamine transporter single-photon emission computed tomography imaging (DaT imaging)—are associated with aspiration risk in patients with MSA.

pmc-12821821.title: Navigating parental concerns in children’s engagement with roblox – a multi-method analysis of emotional and thematic patterns across online communities
pmc-12821821.creator: Sezai Tunca
pmc-12821821.description: This study examines how parents engage with and make sense of their children’s experiences on Roblox, one of the most widely used online gaming platforms for children. Drawing on Reddit comments from three parenting-related communities (r/Parenting, r/internetparents, and r/roblox), the study employs a multi-method approach that integrates BERTopic for thematic modeling, NRC-based sentiment analysis, and Leximancer for conceptual mapping.

pmc-13111213.title: Predictive performance of the SOFA 2.0 score for in-hospital mortality in patients with heat stroke: a multicenter, data-driven subphenotype study
pmc-13111213.creator: Haoming Luo, Yirui Zhu, Tongtong Wang, Weihua Li, Haiyang Guo, Chen Ting, Yuanyuan Ou, Mengshan Guan, Yifeng Zhang, Guoxuan Lin, Zhiguo Pan, Anwei Liu
pmc-13111213.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveHeat stroke can progress rapidly, and the risk of in-hospital mortality increases once multiple organ dysfunction develops. Early risk stratification is therefore clinically important, yet comparative evidence across commonly used severity scores in heat stroke remains limited.MethodsWe conducted a multicenter retrospective cohort study of patients admitted with a first diagnosis of heat stroke to two tertiary hospitals in China between 2013 and 2023.

pmc-13402320.title: Liver fibrosis burden and risk of incident arrhythmia in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease
pmc-13402320.creator: Keungmo Yang, Seung Hyun Kim, Jaejun Lee, Young Chang, Jeong-Ju Yoo, Sae Hwan Lee, Soung Won Jeong, Sang Gyune Kim, Jae Young Jang, Young Seok Kim, Hong Soo Kim, Yongeun Cho, Tom Ryu
pmc-13402320.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a highly prevalent condition associated with increased cardiometabolic risk. While hepatic fibrosis is a determinant of prognosis in MASLD, its relationship with incident arrhythmic outcomes, particularly atrial fibrillation (AF), remains incompletely defined. We investigated whether liver fibrosis burden assessed by noninvasive fibrosis scores is associated with incident electrocardiogram (ECG)-detected arrhythmia in a population-based cohort. We analyzed data from the Lifelines prospective cohort study in the Netherlands.

pmc-13456952.title: Incidence and risk factors for postoperative myocardial infarction following hip and knee arthroplasty
pmc-13456952.creator: Ahmed Al-Saadawi, Saran Singh Gill, Sara Sousi, Gareth G Jones, Alex Bottle, Justin P Cobb, Omar Musbahi
pmc-13456952.description: AimsHip and knee arthroplasty are among the most commonly performed surgical procedures worldwide but carry a risk of cardiovascular complications, including myocardial infarction (MI). Therefore, this study aimed to assess the long-term incidence of MI following hip and knee arthroplasty, and subsequent mortality, in a UK-based cohort.
